reviews.text:
A TRULY exceptional Experience with Infinity Pools of Texas

I can’t say enough good things about my experience with Infinity Pools of Texas. From the very first conversation to the final walkthrough, Carl Poston, his brothers and the entire crew were nothing short of amazing. They treated me like family—something you don’t often find in the world of construction—and approached my project with the kind of care and dedication as if they were building a pool for their own home.

What truly sets Carl and his team apart is their integrity, professionalism, and commitment to excellence. They not only delivered everything they promised, but they also went above and beyond—without a single cost overrun. In today’s world, that’s almost unheard of. Every step of the process was transparent, honest, and stress-free.

Before finding Carl, I had signed with a well-known pool builder who had been featured on a popular TV show. That experience quickly turned into a nightmare—after taking my deposit, they began playing games, trying to nickel and dime me for every little thing. It was frustrating and disheartening. Thankfully, I found Carl and Infinity Pools of Texas, and it was a complete 180 from my previous experience.

Carl uses only the best materials, top-of-the-line equipment, and his designs are truly unique and custom-tailored. He listened to what I wanted, offered thoughtful suggestions, and created a pool that exceeded my expectations in every way. The craftsmanship is outstanding, and the attention to detail is evident in every inch of the finished product.

Today, I have a dream pool—something I had always hoped for but never imagined would turn out this perfectly. More importantly, I have positive memories of the entire process, thanks to Carl and his team. They made what could have been a stressful project into an enjoyable and exciting journey.

If you’re considering building a pool, do yourself a favor and call Infinity Pools of Texas. You won’t find a more trustworthy, talented, and genuinely caring team. Carl and his brothers are the real deal, and I’m beyond grateful I found them.

Pictures truly do not do it justice!!
reviews.author: Peter Mason

reviews.text: Highly recommend Infinity pools! We had a great experience from start to finish. Carl designed the perfect pool for our family and easily worked within the limitations of our yard due to the septic system. They seamlessly integrated our existing patio to the pool deck, all covered with beautiful travertine. Our project manager, Keegan, kept us well informed thru the build and had us swimming in the pool in less than 8 weeks from breaking ground.
reviews.author: Katherine Toor

reviews.text:
I am absolutely thrilled with the pool building experience I had with Infinity Pools! From the initial consultation all the way to pool opening, Tom’s professionalism and expertise were evident every step of the way.

The craftsmanship is truly exceptional. It's clear that they take immense pride in their work, and the attention to detail is remarkable. They used only the highest quality materials, which gives me confidence that my pool will not only be beautiful but also durable and long-lasting.

One of the things I appreciated most was how easy they were to work with. The entire team was communicative, helpful, and always willing to answer my questions. Tom was also quick to respond to any concerns or requests, which made the whole process much less stressful.

I was particularly impressed with their knowledge of modern automation solutions. They integrated the latest technology into my pool, making it incredibly easy to manage and maintain. It has truly elevated my pool experience.

It's also worth noting that this company comes with decades of knowledge. Their experience in the industry was evident in their ability to handle any challenges that arose and provide valuable insights and recommendations.

We absolutely love the pool features and so do friends and family. Everyone that has seen the pool has remarked on just how tasteful all the design elements are, but more importantly, how much fun it is! We look forward to many more years of enjoying our pool.

I highly recommend Infinity Pools to anyone looking for a top-tier pool building experience.
reviews.author: Eric Thone

reviews.text:
Infinity Pools of Texas didn't just install a pool; they created an oasis. From the very beginning, their team transformed our backyard into a haven of relaxation and fun for the whole family. The owner, Carl, worked closely with us to design a unique layout that perfectly suited our needs and desires. Every request we had was met with enthusiasm and attention to detail.

Their dedication to making our dream pool a reality was evident in every step of the process. Not only did they meet our expectations, but they went above and beyond, exceeding them in every way possible. Even after the project was completed, their commitment to our satisfaction remained unwavering.

Carl and his team didn't disappear once the pool was installed; they continued to follow up with us and check in on the pool's maintenance to ensure that we felt comfortable with everything. What started as a business relationship with Infinity Pools has blossomed into a lifelong friendship with Carl and his team.

We're not just satisfied with our pool; we're absolutely thrilled with it!! Thanks to Infinity pools of Texas, our backyard has become our favorite place to spend time together as a family and for a hangout with friends! We couldn't be happier with the result, and we 1000% have Infinity Pools to thank for it!
reviews.author: Cheyn Knizeski

reviews.text: Just WOW!!! We are a new home owner with a previously built Infinity Pool. Although the pool is a top of the line pool, the service and attention that we have received from Tom and his team have been even better. I would not have expected such awesome treatment from a company that worked with the previous home owner, and now has set us up for success. The pool was done right and the continued customer service is hard to find these days. We could not be more excited about our new house with our Infinity Pool.
reviews.author: Small Cattleman

reviews.text:
Carl, Casey, James, Tom and Katelyn have been fantastic. Great team and amazing finish product. I shopped around and received estimates from Keith Zars, Cody Pools, Blue Haven, and several other and decided to go with Infinity Pools of Texas. I am thankful I did.

On 14 Nov 2023 was the stake out and pool had water in it on 18 Feb 2024. Amazing contractors that do excavating, steal, plumbing, pool decking, etc…. Every step of the process was explained and they maintained the schedule and communicated every step and process thoroughly. Amazing final product.

If you are looking for quality, look no further. There is no comparison! Final touches and attention to details will not be matched or beaten.

Thank you for all the professionalism a extremely hard-work put into this project.
reviews.author: Daniel Saenz

reviews.text:
Here is a detailed breakdown of our experience with Infinity Pools.
Design: 5
Quality of Product: 5
Staff and Subcontractors: 5
Addressing Urgent Matters That Arose: 5
Would We Recommend to Others: Yes

Design: To accommodate the pool size we desired, we needed to adjust the retaining wall in our backyard. We spoke with multiple companies and their design was by far the best one presented to us. The project's cost was more favorable compared to that of their primary high-end competitor as well.

Quality of Product: The project is complete, and it looks stunning. They've incorporated numerous intricate details that elevate the quality of their delivered work to a high-end standard.

Staff and subcontractors: We hold their staff in high regard. Every individual is personable and exceptionally friendly. The subcontractors have been pleasant as well.

Addressing Urgent Matters That Arose: We had two issues arise during the project, both of which they promptly responded to and resolved within 24 hours.

Would We Recommend to Others: Without hesitation, for those whose top priority is to obtain a high quality product product at a reasonable price.
reviews.author: Hazim Thomas

reviews.text: Infinity Pools created our dream poolscape.  They were extremely supportive and patient with us as we designed our perfect pool.  They easily accommodated all of our change requests.  They continue to promptly respond whenever we need help with a maintenance issue.  Wonderful pool company.1
reviews.author: Frank Smith

data.summary: The reviews for Infinity Pool Contractors appear overwhelmingly authentic. The high rating is supported by detailed, specific customer testimonials and a clean BBB record. The lack of negative reviews or complaint patterns is notable but not inherently suspicious for a smaller, highly-rated contractor. The primary 'fake' signal is the uniformly exceptional praise, but the content suggests genuine customer satisfaction.
fake_signals: High volume of extremely detailed, glowing 5-star reviews
Some reviews have a similar promotional tone
authentic_signals: Specific details (owner name 'Carl Poston', crew, project constraints like septic systems)
Mentions of a prior negative experience with another builder adds credibility
BBB accreditation and A+ rating with no complaints found
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one primary review source (Google) is available with a high rating, which is consistent with the BBB A+ accreditation. No contradictory low ratings were found on other platforms.
